lines: No matter where I go
I hit a dead end, and then my breath
just goes spilling out somewhere, unchanged
Everyone carries that inferiority, that conflict
The reason is the same
Huh?
Ah
Isn't this a world that wants everything it can get?
I'm being swallowed by the world as it turns again
That reason is the same too
Swollen longings, delusions, fantasies, the truth — no, I'm searching for that
That — what is it? I don't know
This — what is it? Into sweet yearning
I fall
Welcome to the dirty night
Everyone's gone rotten down to the core
Welcome to the dirty night
In a world like that, we all huddle close together
Welcome to the dirty night
Everyone weakens from the inside and rots away
Welcome to the dirty night
In a world like that, we all comfort each other
